notes: Granted by the implemented purchase->entitlement grant chain (CORE-MON-003) on a verified buyer-linked purchase via the product->plan->entitlement mapping; backed by AuditAction.EntitlementGranted, emitted by ProductEntitlementGrantService as a platform-level audit fact (CORE-SPEC-002)

Revoked by the monotonic purchase-status revocation (CORE-MON-004) when a refund/cancellation/chargeback drives a buyer-linked purchase to a terminal revoked state (reusing the CORE-MON-003 product->plan->entitlement mapping in reverse); backed by AuditAction.EntitlementRevoked, emitted by ProductEntitlementGrantService as a platform-level audit fact (CORE-SPEC-002)

Command rejected because a quota limit was exceeded; backed by AuditAction.QuotaExceeded, emitted as a tenant-scoped audit fact at the quota-denial sites (workspace create, session create/start, participant join, asset upload-intent) (CORE-SPEC-002)

Client submitted an Apple/Google purchase proof; backed by AuditAction.PurchaseVerificationSubmitted, emitted by the Apple/Google verification endpoints as a platform-level audit fact (the proof is never recorded) (CORE-SPEC-002)

Backend verification succeeded and the purchase was recorded; backed by AuditAction.PurchaseVerificationSucceeded, emitted by the Apple/Google verification endpoints in the record+grant transaction (CORE-SPEC-002)

Backend verification failed (rejected or environment-not-honored) and no entitlement granted; backed by AuditAction.PurchaseVerificationFailed, emitted by the Apple/Google verification endpoints (the rejection detail is never recorded) (CORE-SPEC-002)
Apple/Google notification received; backed by AuditAction.StoreNotificationReceived, emitted by StoreNotificationService on first arrival as a platform-level audit fact (CORE-SPEC-002)
Notification idempotently applied; backed by AuditAction.StoreNotificationProcessed, emitted by StoreNotificationService inside the apply+ledger transaction (CORE-SPEC-002)
Usually not persisted unless debugging/security requires; not audited (no AuditAction) so it stays audit=false (CORE-SPEC-002 binds audit=true IFF an AuditAction backs the event)
